title: Grade 4 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — General Assessment #6

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What do we say when rising from ruku? (1 mark)
   A. Amin
   B. Bismillah
   C. Alhamdulillah alone
   D. Sami'allahu liman hamidah

2. How is a medium najasa cleaned? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore it
   B. Sprinkle once
   C. Wash seven times with soil
   D. Remove it and wash with water until colour, smell and taste go

3. Which is a question to ask before sharing? (1 mark)
   A. Is it true and kind?
   B. Will people like me?
   C. Is it funny only?
   D. Is it new?

4. Which of these is a benefit of exercise? (1 mark)
   A. Less sleep
   B. Stronger muscles and a healthy heart
   C. Weak bones
   D. More diseases

5. Which is a media plan? (1 mark)
   A. Screens at night
   B. No plan
   C. Games all day
   D. One hour after homework, no screens at prayer

6. Which of these is one of Allah's creatures? (1 mark)
   A. A goat
   B. A phone
   C. A chair
   D. A stone wall

7. What should we do to use Allah's names in dua? (1 mark)
   A. Shout
   B. Call on other beings
   C. Call on Him with the name that matches our need
   D. Stay silent

8. If there is solid matter of a najasa, what should you do first? (1 mark)
   A. Cover it
   B. Sprinkle perfume
   C. Ignore it
   D. Remove it

9. Roughly in which direction is the Qibla from most parts of Kenya? (1 mark)
   A. Straight down
   B. South
   C. North
   D. West

10. Who is a "mjomba"? (1 mark)
   A. Grandmother
   B. Cousin
   C. Father's sister
   D. Mother's brother

11. Which of these is a good way to learn the correct sounds of a surah? (1 mark)
   A. Guess from English letters only
   B. Learn only by writing
   C. Read as fast as possible
   D. Listen to a teacher or good reciter and repeat

12. Whose bed did Ali sleep in on the night of the Prophet's migration? (1 mark)
   A. Bilal's
   B. Khadija's
   C. Abu Bakr's
   D. The Prophet's

13. Who recorded the syllabus hadith about brushing teeth? (1 mark)
   A. Khadija
   B. Waraqa
   C. Abu Lahab
   D. Ibn Majah, according to the syllabus

14. Which of these is a trait of the Prophet's character? (1 mark)
   A. Honesty
   B. Boasting
   C. Cheating
   D. Laziness

15. What is taslim? (1 mark)
   A. Dua
   B. Bowing
   C. The ending greeting of the prayer
   D. The beginning of prayer

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Explain the meaning of modesty in dressing. (3 marks)

17. Write a dua using two of Allah's names and explain why you chose them. (4 marks)

18. State the dua for parents and its meaning. (2 marks)

19. Write the names of prophets in the family chain from Ibrahim to Yusuf. (3 marks)

20. What was the Prophet's reply to the angel of the mountains? (3 marks)
pages.answers:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — Sami'allahu liman hamidah
   Allah hears the one who praises Him.

2. D — Remove it and wash with water until colour, smell and taste go
   Wash until the traces have gone.

3. A — Is it true and kind?
   Truth and kindness first.

4. B — Stronger muscles and a healthy heart
   Exercise strengthens the body.

5. D — One hour after homework, no screens at prayer
   A plan sets limits.

6. A — A goat
   Animals are living creatures of Allah.

7. C — Call on Him with the name that matches our need
   Allah told us to call on Him by His names.

8. D — Remove it
   Remove the substance first.

9. C — North
   Makkah lies to the north of Kenya.

10. D — Mother's brother
   Mjomba is mother's brother.

11. D — Listen to a teacher or good reciter and repeat
   Correct Arabic sounds must be learned by listening to a teacher.

12. D — The Prophet's
   He did so to protect the Prophet.

13. D — Ibn Majah, according to the syllabus
   The syllabus names Ibn Majah.

14. A — Honesty
   The Prophet was known as trustworthy and truthful.

15. C — The ending greeting of the prayer
   As-salamu alaykum wa rahmatullah.

SECTION B
----
16. (3 marks)
   Answer: Modesty is haya. It means covering properly and dressing decently without showing off.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for haya, 1 mark for covering, 1 mark for not showing off.

17. (4 marks)
   Answer: For example: "Ya Rahman, Ya Rahim, forgive me and have mercy on me", because I need mercy.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct name, 1 mark for the request, 1 mark for the reason.

18. (2 marks)
   Answer: Rabbir-hamhuma kama rabbayani saghira: My Lord, have mercy on them as they raised me when I was small.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for words and 1 mark for meaning.

19. (3 marks)
   Answer: Ibrahim, Ishaq, Yaqub, Yusuf.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for Ibrahim, 1 for Ishaq and Yaqub, 1 for Yusuf in the right order.

20. (3 marks)
   Answer: He refused to let the people be destroyed and hoped Allah would bring from their descendants people who worship Allah alone.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for refusal, 1 mark for hope, 1 mark for descendants.
